reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.contents: This app is so useful !! My son goes to his grandparents half the week after nursery and this app was brilliant for sharing with family so we were all consistent with potty training.

reviews.title: potty tracking
reviews.contents: Really good app to track potty training and track progress. We don’t pay for the subscription, even without its helpful

reviews.title: Really helped us crack potty training after months of trying
reviews.contents: My little one looks forward to adding her successful trip to the toilet on this app just for the fireworks and stars.

reviews.title: Awesome.
reviews.contents: This is a brilliant app. It tracks the activity (and charts it) and after a successful trip to the potty it has fireworks to encourage the little ones. This is exactly what I needed.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.contents:
Fab app that is helping try to make sense of my DC’s routine/frequency 

Just wish it had a widget for quick adds

reviews.title: Good app but
reviews.contents: When paying for premium to share timers and what not, would appreciate it if it didn’t sign me out every other day.

reviews.title: In-App purchase waste of money
reviews.contents: Inapp purchase a total waste of money nothing additional features gained. I also cannot find an option to cancel it to get my money back! I’m still within my 14 day period as only just downloaded! Really unhappy!

reviews.title: Good but…
reviews.contents: Good app to track and remind for potty training. However after paying for the premium option to share timers, it is quite buggy. Reached out to support three times and got no response so have cancelled the subscription.

reviews.title: Fantastic app!!
reviews.contents:
Had my 3 year old daughter potty trained PLUS toilet trained in just 4 weeks!!

Amazing app!!!  I found the timer helped massively in the first few days...

Sad to remove it but it’s done it’s job now!! 

Goodbye nappies!!
